name: Pumps
scope: One complete 500 mm board-to-motor-tab harness, its Faston end finished through front-top's common rear electrical passage with front-top loose
mapStatus: Circuit and pair order follow the assembly schedule. The white-striped edge is assigned to AM2 as a bench convention; it is not a record of an assembled sample.
overview: Four separate motor conductors run from the J13 JST plug to four insulated female Faston receptacles on the two pumps' motor tabs. The +X pair serves pump A and the −X pair pump B.
overviewFacts: 4 insulated female Fastons · two per pump

ribbons.description: A1 is the white-striped edge and lands on AM2. Count away from it: A2 AM1, A3 BM2, A4 BM1. Peel the pump end into its two pairs back 70 mm, A1/A2 for pump A and A3/A4 for pump B, and part each pair's last 20 mm.

pins.detail: Striped A1 joins J13 cavity 1 / AM2 to pump A's motor tab 2. This is one H-bridge motor lead, not a shared supply.
A2 joins J13 cavity 2 / AM1 to pump A's motor tab 1. Keep it separate from AM2 and both pump-B conductors.
A3 joins J13 cavity 3 / BM2 to pump B's motor tab 2. It carries one pump-B motor lead straight to its tab.
A4 joins J13 cavity 4 / BM1 to pump B's motor tab 1. It is the pump ribbon's −X edge through the shared electrical mouth.

conductors.title: J13 AM2 → pump A motor tab 2
conductors.toPart: Insulated female Faston receptacle · matched to the motor tab
conductors.note: White-striped A1, the ribbon's +X edge in the common rear electrical mouth. It turns +X with A2 along the transverse channel to pump A.

conductors.title: J13 AM1 → pump A motor tab 1
conductors.toPart: Insulated female Faston receptacle · matched to the motor tab
conductors.note: Second conductor counted from the white stripe. It turns +X with A1 along the transverse channel to pump A.

conductors.title: J13 BM2 → pump B motor tab 2
conductors.toPart: Insulated female Faston receptacle · matched to the motor tab
conductors.note: Third conductor counted from the white stripe. It turns −X with A4 along the transverse channel to pump B.

conductors.title: J13 BM1 → pump B motor tab 1
conductors.toPart: Insulated female Faston receptacle · matched to the motor tab
conductors.note: Fourth conductor counted from the white stripe, the ribbon's −X edge. It turns −X with A3 along the transverse channel to pump B.

dress.description: No sleeves, collars or ties. The 4P pump ribbon stays bare below the funnel frame, through the common rear electrical mouth and along the integral transverse channel to the two motor terminal rooms.
dress.qualification: Feed the free pump end through the common passage with front-top loose before crimping the Fastons. Landing the Fastons, motor-first installation with the lower retainer and installed dressing are separate assembly jobs.

materials.label: Cable
materials.detail: 500 mm BNTECHGO 22 AWG black 4P silicone ribbon

materials.label: Other end
materials.detail: 4 insulated female Faston receptacles from the §11 kit, matched to the motor tabs

materials.label: Tools
materials.detail: Stripper · SN-2549 JST crimper · Haisstronica insulated-terminal crimper · flush cutters · multimeter

steps.title: Cut & identify
steps.instruction: Cut one 500 mm 4P ribbon. Call the white-striped edge A1 / AM2, then count A2 / AM1, A3 / BM2 and A4 / BM1. Peel the pump end into its two pairs back 70 mm, A1/A2 for pump A and A3/A4 for pump B, and part each pair's last 20 mm.

steps.title: Crimp the JST end
steps.instruction: Splay and strip the four JST ends. Crimp four SXH-001T-P0.6 contacts, inspect the conductor and insulation barrels, then seat A1–A4 in XHP-4 cavities 1–4. Match cavity 1 to the native PCB AM2 label and the housing circuit-1 mark.

steps.title: Crimp the Fastons
steps.instruction: With front-top loose, feed the free pump end forward through the common rear electrical mouth and out underneath. Keep the XHP-4 aft of the mouth. Strip the four ends and crimp four insulated female Faston receptacles, matched to the motor tabs' width. Inspect and tug each crimp.

steps.title: Ring out & label
steps.instruction: With the XHP-4 unplugged and the Fastons not yet landed, ring out each XHP-4 cavity to its Faston and check all six pairs for isolation. Check contact retention. Label the housing J13 · PUMPS and stage it for motor-first installation into front-top.

estimateBasis: 5 attended minutes per finished J13 at unit 25: 0.5 minute to cut, identify and split the pump end, 1.5 minutes for four JST crimps and housing insertion, 2 minutes to feed the free end through the shared electrical passage and crimp four insulated Fastons, and 1 minute to ring out and label. One practiced person completes the piece start to finish with the map, materials and hand tools ready and front-top loose; shared setup is amortized. Ten minutes is the upper planning allowance. This is a theoretical, unmeasured estimate. It excludes development and lookup, landing the Fastons, installing the pumps and lower retainer, and cabinet routing.
